A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
natural language understanding is a very difficult task, and it is not clear that it can be done well without a great deal of prior knowledge.
the design of verbal interfaces to domestic robots is a challenging task that requires a combination of speech recognition, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence techniques.
the design of a robot that can be instructed by verbal commands is a very challenging task, and that the design of robot learning capabilities is a key issue in this context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a robot’s learning capabilities are crucial for its ability to adapt to its users’ needs.
a robot should not only be able to execute a task, but it should also understand how the task is specified by the human.
a robot should be able to understand the user’s intentions in a way that is similar to the way humans understand each other.
